title: Liberation of Rimavská Sobota
description:
**Rimavská Sobota** was liberated on December 11, 1944, by Soviet and Romanian forces during World War II, ending the Nazi occupation of the town.

The town had been under German control and was part of the Slovak State, a Nazi puppet regime. The liberation came as part of the broader Eastern Front offensive that was pushing German forces westward through Central Europe.

The town suffered significant damage during the war, including the destruction of much of its Jewish community during the Holocaust. Before the war, Rimavská Sobota had a vibrant Jewish population that contributed greatly to the town's commercial and cultural life. The liberation marked the beginning of reconstruction and the transition to communist rule under Czechoslovakia.
